title: Gandrel's Aspiration

sources.title: Feller of Monsters
markers: | summary = '''Feller of Monsters''' is a passive feature that improves hit chance against Monstrosities.

sources.title: Sacred Munitions
markers: | description = Infuse your crossbow bolts with holy energy. For the rest of your turn, your ranged weapon attacks inflict {{SmCond|Turned}} against [[undead]].

summary: Gain advantage on attacks against Monstrosities while this +1 heavy crossbow is equipped. Sacred Munitions lets ranged attacks turn Undead.

fields.Weapon damage: 1d10 + 1 Piercing plus the wielder’s Dexterity modifier. +1 enchantment also improves attack rolls. Martial, two-handed ranged weapon, 60 ft range, dippable.
fields.Weapon actions: With proficiency, gain Piercing Shot and Brace (Ranged).
fields.Sacred Munitions: Self, Bonus Action once per Short Rest. For the rest of this turn, hits with ranged weapon attacks inflict Turned on Undead for 3 turns without a saving throw. Clerics with Destroy Undead also deal 4d6 Radiant to those targets.
fields.Turned: The creature flees, cannot willingly move within 30 ft of you, and cannot spend its Reaction. It can Dash or try to escape movement restraints. Damage ends Turned early.
fields.Base value: 130 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
